episode.showDescription: Design is everywhere in our lives, perhaps most importantly in the places where we've just stopped noticing. 99% Invisible is a weekly exploration of the process and power of design and architecture. From award winning producer Roman Mars. Learn more at 99percentinvisible.org.

transcript_window.text: But despite all that, Michael thought that what was known about Charles Page's achievements was certainly worth sharing.
So he started writing articles and appearing on any local news media that would have him.
I'm on television a lot here and radio and everything.
And I was talking about Page and I get a call from Joe and he said, I'm his grandson.
I said, I hope you're happy with everything I'm doing.
He says, I'm ecstatic with everything you're doing.
tried to fight this when I was young, trying to get the word out.
And people just, it's either one of two things.
They don't believe you or they don't want to believe you.
